subject: Brookfield trial runbook and responsibility matrix
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@brookfieldretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Brookfield trial runbook and responsibility matrix

Hi Aisha — thanks for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and a proposed runbook for the 4-week trial so we can align stakeholders and unblock next steps. I attached a draft runbook (PDF) and an evaluation metrics workbook.

Highlights / ask from us:
- Proposed kickoff: Tuesday, Nov 3 — initial 60-min kickoff to confirm data access and test accounts.
- Weekly check-ins: 30-minute syncs on Fridays to review intermediate metrics and blockers.
- Success criteria (draft): 1) >= 90% intent classification accuracy on labeled sample; 2) average response latency under 400ms for 512-token requests in your environment; 3) integration test: search reranking improves CTR by relative +10% in the pilot dataset.
- Owners: Brookfield IT for data access (see action item: provide S3 read role or sample export), Redwood to stand up trial model and evaluation harness.

Next steps we need from Brookfield by EOD Thu:
1) Confirm kickoff attendee list (engineering, security, analytics).
2) Provide a contact for IT / infra (name + email) to coordinate the test bucket and VPC peering if required.
3) Confirm any restricted time windows for network access/tests.

Attachments:
- brookfield-trial-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook, milestones, gating criteria)
- evaluation-metrics-brookfield.xlsx (workbook with suggested labels, eval scripts)
- redwood-privacy-summary.pdf (short summary for your security team)

If the dates above don't work, propose an alternate week. Happy to lock in a canary test if you prefer a smaller initial scope.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0139
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@brookfieldretail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brookfieldretail.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brookfieldretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Brookfield trial runbook and responsibility matrix

Thanks, Stephanie — this looks like a solid starting point. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Stakeholders: please add Liam (IT lead) and Priya (security/compliance). Liam will handle the S3 role and any VPC/network changes, Priya will need the redwood-privacy-summary.pdf for internal review.
2) Timeline: Nov 3 kickoff is feasible but we'd prefer a 90-min kickoff to walk Priya through the security posture and to allow Liam time to confirm access requirements. Can we do Nov 3 at 10:00am ET?
3) Success criteria: the accuracy and latency targets look reasonable — can you confirm whether latency is measured from Redwood-hosted endpoints or from our VPC (we have different expectations)? Also we need an item for data loss prevention: ensure logs do not contain PII in transit for the evaluation set.
4) Data sample: we can provide a 10k-row sanitized export by Friday; we'll flag fields with PHI/PII so your team can validate.

One ask: can you include a short section in the runbook that describes rollback/fallback behavior if performance regresses mid-trial? Our legal/security team likes an explicit contingency plan.

Appreciate it — I added Liam and Priya to the thread.

Best,
Aisha Malik
Head of AI Product | Brookfield Retail
aisha.malik@brookfieldretail.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@brookfieldretail.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brookfieldretail.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brookfieldretail.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brookfield trial runbook and responsibility matrix

Looping in internal owners and proposing concrete owners/times based on Aisha's asks.

Proposed responsibilities / short plan:
- Kickoff (Nov 3, 10:00am ET): Stephanie will run the kickoff and cover success criteria & schedule (90 mins). Marissa will present evaluation plan and metric definitions (20 mins). Ben will cover infra checklist and permissions (15 mins).
- Infra & access (owner: Ben):
  * Create test account and sandbox model on Redwood Dedicated trial cluster (target: Nov 2 setup complete).
  * Share S3 role ARNs and a small verification script for Liam to run.
- Evaluation & metrics (owner: Marissa):
  * Finalize evaluation workbook with the labeled subset (target: Nov 1).
  * Include a simple regression test and rollback triggers (we'll add an explicit contingency section per Aisha's ask).
- Security/compliance (owner: Stephanie + Ben):
  * Provide redwood-privacy-summary.pdf and a short runbook paragraph on rollback + log redaction.

Milestones (high level):
1) Oct 30: Redwood to deliver updated runbook with rollback section and clarified latency measurement (in-runbook).
2) Nov 1: Brookfield delivers sanitized 10k sample + confirm IAM details.
3) Nov 2: Redwood completes sandbox provisioning and shares test credentials/verification script.
4) Nov 3: Kickoff (90 mins) + align on first week tasks.
5) Weekly (Fri): 30-min syncs; final readout week of Nov 30.

I'll take action to update the runbook (v1 -> v1.1) today and attach it to HubSpot. Marissa — can you add the regression/rollback checklist into the evaluation workbook and share by COB?

Thanks — I will add the verification script and infra notes to the drive link.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@brookfieldretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brookfieldretail.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brookfieldretail.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brookfield trial runbook and responsibility matrix

Perfect — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming the updated plan below so everyone has a single source of truth before the kickoff.

Confirmed items:
- Kickoff: Nov 3, 2026 at 10:00am ET (90 minutes). Calendar invite to follow.
- Weekly cadence: Fridays, 30 minutes, 11:00am ET starting Nov 6.
- Deliverables: Redwood will send runbook v1.1 (includes rollback section and latency measurement definition) by EOD today, and Marissa will share the revised evaluation workbook by COB tomorrow (Nov 1).
- Data/sample: Brookfield will provide sanitized 10k sample + IAM contact (Liam) by Nov 1.
- Acceptance gates: the three draft success criteria remain the pilot readout basis; we'll refine thresholds in-week 1.

If there are any calendar conflicts, please flag them in-reply and we'll adjust. Looking forward to the kickoff — we'll share the drive link and HubSpot deal update soon.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
